jobs.description:
**Job Requirements**  

"We Power the Magic!" That's our motto at Disney Experiences Technology (DXT). Our team creates world-class immersive digital experiences for the Company's premier vacation brands, including Disney's Parks & Resorts. We are responsible for the end-to-end digital and physical Guest experience for all technology and digital-led initiatives across Food & Beverage, and Merchandise lines of business.

This role sits within the Retail & Restaurant Technology organization and supports the Point of Sale (POS) platform — the system that powers every merchandise and dining transaction across our parks and resorts. Our platform is a large-scale, distributed, event-driven system. We work with a polyglot stack (PHP, Go, Python, Java) that we are actively modernizing, and we need engineers who embrace the platform as it is while helping shape what it becomes. The main client of our services is the POS terminal itself — an Android-based hardware device used by thousands of Cast Members every day — so reliability, performance, and thoughtful API design directly impact the Guest and Cast experience.

The Lead Software Engineer will report to the Manager, Software Engineering.

What You Will Do

* Lead and personally build (hands-on coding expected) scalable, well-documented backend services and APIs across our polyglot platform — PHP and Go microservices today, with a growing Java/Spring footprint — from technical specification through production delivery.
* Set architectural direction for the POS platform: translate complex functional, technical, and business requirements into solution and system designs, produce architecture diagrams and proof-of-concepts, evaluate technology choices, and ensure new solutions integrate cleanly with surrounding Disney systems.
